abstract.p: The centering pins (8) on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) are fitted into the pin recesses (10) on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) and these two reinforcing pieces are fixed on the door by screwing through the corresponding screw holes (9, 14) on both pieces. The door handle connecting part (4) is placed into the groove (7) on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2). The wing (6) below the door handle (1) is inserted into the guide plate (5) on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) by sliding and the pin (13) at the end of the door handle (1) is pressed onto the door handle connecting part (4) and the door handle (1) is placed onto the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2). The door handle (1) is secured on the door by screwing it through the screw hole (15) on the lateral side of the door handle (1). In case of a problem, it can be solved by merely dismounting the door handle (1).

Les goupilles de centrage (8) situées sur la partie de renforcement interne (3) de cette poignée de porte sont adaptées dans des évidements (10) ménagés dans la partie de renforcement externe (2) de cette poignée de porte et ces deux parties de renforcement sont fixées sur la porte par vissage dans des trous de vis correspondants (9, 14) situés sur les deux parties. La pièce d'assemblage (4) de cette poignée de porte est placée dans la rainure (7) ménagée dans la partie de renforcement externe (2) de cette poignée de porte. Le rabat (6) situé sous la poignée de porte (1) est introduit dans la plaque guide (5) se trouvant sur la partie de renforcement externe (2) de la poignée de porte par coulissement et la goupille (13) située à l'extrémité de la poignée de porte (1) est pressée sur la pièce d'assemblage (4) de la poignée de porte (1), laquelle est placée sur la partie de renforcement externe (2). Cette poignée de porte (1) est assujettie sur la porte par vissage dans le trou de vis (15) ménagé sur le côté de la poignée de porte (1). En cas de problème, l'ajustage s'effectue par simple démontage de cette poignée de porte (1).

description.p: REFRIGERATOR DOOR-HANDLE

The present invention is related to the refrigerator door handles and particularly to those designed for plastic doors, which are fixed on the holders and guide plates that are placed on both sides of the door exterior plastic material before filling with polyurethane.,

The conventional door handles made of metal or plastics are attached on the reinforcing pieces fastened on the inner side of the door, in such a manner that they remain in the polyurethane, by means of bolts and similar material. The door handles are fastened on the door by means of catches and recesses formed on the said pieces and rigidity is provided by the polyurethane. In the domestic type refrigerators the door handles are flush-mounted in contact with the polyurethane and when a problem arises with regard to the door handle, the door is required to be replaced entirely as the handle cannot be removed from the door. This process is time consuming and costly. Furthermore, since the door handle is integrated with the door, there are certain restrictions during the industrial design stage.

The object of the present invention is to provide an easy mounting/dismounting process for the door handle which is seated onto a guide plate on the door, independently from the door by means of a screw holding the door handle on its side.
The door handle and guide plate realised in order to attain the object of the present invention are illustrated in the drawings, wherein:
Figure 1- is the overall view of the inner reinforcing piece of the door handle,

Figure 2, is the overall view of the outer reinforcing piece of the door handle, Figure 3, is the view showing the door handle connecting part
Figure 4, is the view of the door handle connecting part as mounted on the door handle outer reinforcing piece,
Figure 5, is the view showing the door handle as mounted on the door handle outer reinforcing piece, Figure 6, is the side view of the door handle.
Figure 7, is the bottom of the door handle,
Figure 8, is the view of the door handle as mounted on the door handle inner and outer reinforcing pieces.
The components shown in the drawings have been numerated as follows:
1. Door handle
2. Door handle outer reinforcing piece
3. Door handle inner reinforcing piece 4. Door handle connecting part
5. Guide plate
6. Wing
7. Groove
8. Centering pins 9. Screw holes on the door handle inner reinforcing piece
10. Centering pin recess
11. Channel
12. Hole
13. Door handle pin 14. Screw holes on the door handle outer reinforcing piece
15. Door handle screw hole

The door handle assembly consists of three major components; namely the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) placed inside the door, the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) placed between the door and the door handle (1), also
including the door handle adapter (4), which ensures the fitting of the door handle (1) on the door; and the door handle (1).

The door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) is a rectangular plastic plate with rounded edges. The said reinforcing piece is provided with screw holes (9) at suitable points in order to allow the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) to be mounted on the door. Gaps of various shapes and numbers are left inside the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) for a better setting of the polyurethane. Furthermore, centering pins (8) on the surface have been formed on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) for its easy mounting on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3). (FigJ). The door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) situated between the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) and door handle (1) consists of a guide plate (5) and a door handle connecting part (4) manufactured independently from the said single piece, which shall serve as the locking part. The door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) is a triangular plate with rounded edges, wherein all angles of the triangle are acute. The guide (5) which is formed as one-piece with the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2), so that the wing (6) on the door handle (1) can be inserted in it with both sides bent inwards and with a gap in the middle; extends from the base to the vertex of the triangle. Besides there is a hollow rectangular groove (7) with a width and length suitable to the end of the door handle adapter (4), at the vertex point, just below the screw hole (14). The door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) is provided with screw holes (14), to meet the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3). Furthermore there are two centering pin recesses (10) placed in conformity with the centering pins (8) on the door handle reinforcing piece (3), (FigJ).

The door handle connecting part (4) is formed of a monobloc cylinder with a hole (12) at the center, around which channels (11) with pre-determined depths have been formed at right angles, the cylinder being placed on a platform that consists of a two-stepped cascade with different heights (FigJ). The section below the part that forms the base of the cylinder is slightly longer than the latter, in the door
handle connecting part (4). This longer part is inserted into the rectangular groove (7) that has a suitable width and length for receiving the longer end of the door handle connecting part (4), which is on the top of the outer reinforcing piece (2), just below the screw hole opened for the passage of the screw; and is attached on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) (Fig.4).

The centering pins (8) on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) are inserted into the centering pin recesses (10) on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) and are thus attached on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) and both, i.e. inner (3) and outer (2) reinforcing pieces are mounted on the door by screwing through the corresponding screw holes (9 and 14) that are present on the said pieces.

Just below the door handle (1), there is a wing (6) placed on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2), to be engaged to the guide plate (5). The said wing (6) is a plastic monobloc piece manufactured with the door handle (1), which has a projection on both sides and which is connected to the doorhandle (1) by means of a cross-piece at the middle. Furthermore, a door handle pin (13) is provided on the door handle (1) end, formed so as to enter the channels (11) and hole (12) at the door handle connecting part (4) in order to provide connection with the said door handle connecting part (4). The wing (6) is engaged into the guide plate (5) by sliding and the pin (13) at the end of the doorhandle (1) is fitted on the cylinder, which has been placed on the two stepped platform and which has a hole (12) in the middle and right-angled channels (11) of certain depths around the hole, by pressing and finally the door handle (1) is screwed through the screw hole (15) opened on the lateral side of the door outer plastics, surface, in order to complete the connection and therefore the mounting operation of the door handle
(1) to the door.

As the door handle (1) is manufactured separately from the door, in case a problem arises at the door handle, the doorhandle (1) can be dismounted easily by
unscrewing the said screw on the lateral side, by pulling the pin (13) at the end of the door handle (1), that has been fitted on the door handle connecting part (4) and by sliding the wing (6) on the guide plate (5) backwards in order to take it out; thus loss of time and costly service procedure is avoided. Furthermore, the door handle (1) can be manufactured in various forms and patterns, which in turn provides facility of usage and visual attractiveness for the choice of the user.

claim.claim-text: 1. A refrigerator door-handle including a door-handle outer reinforcing piece (2) placed between the door and the door handle (1), which facilitates the mounting of the door handle (1) on the door, and a door handle connecting part (4), characterized with, a door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) which has on its surface centering pins (8) for the mounting of the said outer reinforcing piece (2), and which is formed of a rectangular plastic plate the edges of which are rounded, and which is mounted on the door via screws together with the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2).

2. A refrigerator door-handle characterized with the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) formed in a triangular shape with rounded corners and with all angles of the triangle are acute, and including a guide plate (5), which extends from the base of the door-handle outer reinforcing piece (2) to the vertex opposite to the base, is bent inwards and has a cavity in the centre so that a wing (6) formed on the door handle (1) can be inserted in it, and a rectangular groove (7) with a width and length suitable to the door handle connecting part (4), and centering pin recesses (10), and screw holes (14).

3. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1 and 2, characterized with a door handle connecting part (4) consisting of a cylinder with a hole (12) in the middle, around which channels (11) with determined depths have been formed at right angles, the clinder being placed on a platform which is located on an elongated which is longer, but not higher than the platform.

4. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-3, characterized in that the elongated part of the door handle connecting part (4) is inserted into the rectangular groove (7) that has the suitable width and length for receiving the longer end of the door handle connecting part (4), and which is on the top of
the outer reinforcing piece (2), just below the screw hole (14) opened for the passage of the screw.

5. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-4, characterized in that the centering pins (8) on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) are inserted into the centering pin recesses (10) on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) and that the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) is fixed on the door outer plastic surface so that it rests on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3), by screwing through the corresponding screw holes (9J4) that are present in the same number on both pieces.

6. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-5, characterized in that the wing (6) is inserted into the guide plate (5) on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) which is fixed to the outer plastic surface of the door, by sliding and that when the wing (6) is completely fitted on the guide plate (5), the pin (13) provided on the door handle is seated on the said cylinder of the door handle connecting part (4), that has been placed on the two-stepped platform, and which has a central hole (12) and right angled channels (11) of determined depths around the hole, by pressing and at the same time, fixing the door handle (1) onto the door, by being screwed throughout the screw hole (15) on its lateral side.

7. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-6, characterized in that the doorhandle (1) can be dismounted easily by unscrewing the said screw on the lateral side, by pulling out the pin (13) which is at the end point of the door handle (1) and which has been fitted out the hollow (12) cylinder of the door handle connecting part (4) placed on the two-stepped platform, consisting of channels (11) at right angles, with givendepths around the said hole (12), and by sliding the wing (6) on the guide plate (5) backwards in order to take it out.

8. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-7 characterized with the centering pins (8) on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) that enables the fixation of the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2) onto the door outer plastic surface in such a manner that it rests on the door handle inner reinforcing piece (3) by centering and fixing the said centering pins (8) into the centering pin recesses on the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2).

9. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-8, characterized with the guide plate (5) provided in the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2), into which the wing (6) of the door handle (1) is inserted by sliding.

10. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-9, characterized with the wing (6) with projections on each side, being formed as a monobloc plastic part with the door handle (1) and is connected to the doorhandle (1) by means of a cross-piece at the middle, which is engaged into the guide plate (5) in the door handle outer reinforcing piece (2).

11. A refrigerator door handle according to Claims 1-10, characterized with the door handle pin (13) which is provided on the door handle (1) end, formed so as to enter the channels (11) and hole (12) at the door handle connecting part
(4) in order to provide connection with the said door handle connecting part
